label: ManufacturingChangeCompliance process: Coordinate Procurement and Supplier Adjustments — Update purchase orders and vendor commitments to align supplier delivery schedules and material specifications with the modified production plan.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY FINDING - ManufacturingChangeCompliance Process:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Directly part of proc_ManufacturingChangeCompliance_v1 (BPMN process group)
- Orchestrates engineering changes across production materials and items
- Key capabilities: manage-change-impact, schedule-machines, orchestrate-production-change, synchronize-engineering-change
- Coordinates with material and product item management for production order adjustments
- Related to EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem entities
- DOCUMENT ENGINEERING CHANGE: This agent orchestrates engineering changes which necessarily involves creating and publishing formal change records as part of its workflow

PROCUREMENT/SUPPLIER COORDINATION FOR MANUFACTURING CHANGES:
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1
- Automates coordination of material updates and engineering changes across procurement workflows
- Monitors engineering changes, automatically coordinating updates across purchase orders and product items
- Validates material specifications against compliance requirements
- Ensures propagation of updates through procurement network
- Related to EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem, PurchaseOrder entities
- PERFECT FIT for: Coordinate Procurement and Supplier Adjustments activity

Supporting API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1
- REST API for creating, updating, monitoring purchase orders
- Capabilities: coordinate-vendor-procurement, validate-purchase-orders, verify-vendor-compliance
- Exposes PurchaseOrder, Vendor entities

EHS SAFETY COMPLIANCE:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
- Monitors engineering changes, materials, product items for safety compliance

ITSC CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
corp.itsm has ChangeAutomationOrchestrator and ChangeReleaseCoordinator agents
siemens.plm has EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning agent
